summary: Morrisville‑Eaton Central School District urges the FCC to preserve E‑Rate funding and avoid any reductions that would shift costs to local budgets and reduce educational resources.

claims.argument: Eliminating or reducing E‑Rate would transfer telecommunications costs to local school budgets, forcing cuts to instructional programs and technology replacements.
